This solid 925 sterling silver skull ring is a heavy men's biker ring with a bold gothic look. It is handmade for buyers who want real silver, strong detail, and a ring that feels substantial on the hand.

💀 HEAVY. SOLID. BUILT TO LAST.

This is a heavyweight, solid 925 sterling silver skull ring — not hollow, not plated — made for those who don’t follow trends, they define them.

• Approx. 26g+ weight — solid, substantial feel
• Size: 24 × 19 mm — compact but powerful presence
• Made from real 925 sterling silver — no plating, no fading
• Oxidized + polished finish for deep contrast

⚔️ BUILT FOR REAL WEAR

Designed for daily use, with a smooth inner band for comfort and a bold exterior that stands out.

You don’t just wear it — it becomes part of your identity.

🔥 FOR THOSE WHO LIVE LOUD

Worn by those who ride hard, think independently, and don’t ask for permission.

Perfect for:
• Biker style
• Gothic fashion
• Punk / rock culture
• Men who want bold, no-compromise jewelry

Each ring is hand-finished, bringing out:

• Deep shadows and aggressive skull details
• Unique texture and character
• Slight variations — no two rings are identical

✅ MATERIAL YOU CAN TRUST

Made from real 925 sterling silver (not plated or coated), built to last for years without fading or peeling.

A powerful gift for him — perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, or anyone who appreciates bold, masculine jewelry.

Available in multiple sizes.
